plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Monroe University 2026-2027 University Catalog (catalog.monroeu.edu). Semester placement is the catalog's printed Recommended Sequence; every semester sums to the grid's printed 15 credits and the plan to the program's printed total. The queue's 2025-2026 edition is not published or archived on the official catalog site (its archives list only 2024-2025 and 2023-2024), so the current 2026-2027 edition was collected. Requirements list cross-check: Major-Related Courses subtotal 18 + Major Area Component Courses and Electives subtotal 12 (BL-201 plus Major Area Electives 9, satisfied in the sequence by the Business/Marketing Elective slots) + General Education and Related Courses subtotal 30 = 60. The catalog page also publishes concentrations (Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Marketing), each requiring a minimum of three courses (9 credits) from the selected concentration, satisfied through the Major Area Electives per the catalog footnote.

courses.title: Business Elective 1 or Marketing Elective
courses.choice_note: Printed in the sequence as 'MG-ELE or MK-ELE - Business Elective 1 or Marketing Elective'. Sequence footnotes: the slot should relate to the declared Concentration if applicable, or MG-290 Business Administration Internship I is recommended; a second footnote gives the same concentration wording with MG-230 Principles of Project Management.
